current.employer_linkedin_description: At YangKiez, #MomoMami we are committed to raising the bar for Asian cuisine. Founded in 2018, our mission is to provide high-quality, hygienic, and healthy momos, dumplings, and springrolls that exceed customer expectations.Our founders have been in the business of providing delicious and healthy Asian cuisine since 2014. With the launch of YangKiez, we have taken the next step by creating our own brand, which allows us to provide our customers with direct access to our products and innovations. We strive to use only the freshest and highest quality ingredients, and we are dedicated to using steaming as our primary cooking method, as it is the most healthy way to prepare food while retaining its flavour and nutrients.We are built on a foundation of strong values, customer focus, and a code of ethics. We are dedicated to providing our customers with cost-effective, healthy and hygienic food options. With our vision to serve Pan India, we are focused on continuing to raise the bar for Asian cuisine, and we hope to have you along for the ride. Join us in revolutionizing the way India eats

First pitcher and season opener at #sharktankindiaIncubated @NSRCEL-IIM Bangalore & Accelerator Program @Technoserve.A Young Food Start-Up Company of Self Estabilished Entrepreneurs.One of The First Mover in Frozen Momos & Springrolls.Make In India by North Eastern Indian Himalayan, Handcrafted with Love & Care.Convenient, Authentic & Healthy Natural Food.Innovation is at Every Step.Promoting Agro Produce, Reducing Decay & Wastage.  Our Founder comes from a rich cultural background of Hill States in North-East having the expertise to create authentic North-Eastern cuisine, with our Founder being the Top 7 of Amul Master Chef and a Corporate Japanese MNC Experience of over 12 Years, & Our Co-Founders  are the Alumnus of Amity Business School & MNIT.We are foodies with a mission to provide the society with the highest quality of authentic cuisine, in the most hygienic way while delivering value for your money.  Our Values: - Trust: it is for me to gain, not for you to have.- Respect: the diversity and talent what each individual has.- Agility: learn new things & be ready always to deploy it with speed in the most Ambiguous environment.- Everytime right on right time. past.employer_linkedin_description: We help leading organizations to become future-focused. We are a strategy and innovation consultancy focused on helping our clients to take advantage of change and to develop the foresight, flexibility and focus to win in uncertain markets. Our strategy and innovation practices help them to discover, develop and deliver opportunities to grow beyond the reach of traditional strategy, assumed capabilities and boundaries.We focus on excellence as reflected in our 100% return client rate, with all Stratalis' clients returning for a second engagement within one year of their first. We focus on creative growth strategies and innovation execution on products, services and business models to deliver increased profitability, improved efficiency and superior return on investment for our client organizations.
past.employee_description:
I was a member of the APAC for Stratalis with a focus on Corporate Strategy and Technology Research. I advised Fortune 500 companies (Mining and Industrials) on how to outperform in uncertain markets.

The Stratalis Group is a global strategy and innovation consultancy focused on helping their clients to become future-focused and to deliver tangible opportunities for growth. They advise market leaders on how to develop foresight around future opportunity and risk, strategic flexibility to adapt and organizational focus to guide and inspire.

past.employer_linkedin_description: YES BANK is a leading Indian private sector bank committed to transforming the financial landscape of India. With over 1200 branches nationwide and a dedicated team of YES BANKers, we strive to deliver exceptional banking solutions and empower individuals, businesses and communities to thrive. At YES BANK, we believe in the power of innovation and transparency. Operating in Retail, MSME and Corporate banking sectors, we are a full service bank and offer an extensive range of financial services. We leverage cutting-edge technology & industry insights to meet the evolving needs of our diverse clientele. One in three UPI transactions in the country are processed by YES BANK.Driven by our core values, we aim to build long lasting relationships with our customers and stakeholders. Our robust risk management framework ensures the safety and security of your finances, while our unwavering commitment to sustainability drives us to create a positive impact on society and the environment. We recognize the potential within each person and strive to unlock it through opportunities for growth, learning and innovation. Joining our ranks means joining a vibrant ecosystem of individuals who are passionate about making an impact and shaping the future of banking. Together, let’s create a future where your dreams can flourish and make a lasting impact.Note: YES BANK will NEVER ask you to reveal your User ID or Password. Therefore, never disclose your credentials (User ID, Password, OTP, PIN etc.) to anyone either through mail or over phone. If you receive any mail asking you to update or authenticate your User ID or Password, please DO NOT fall into the trap of putting in your Password or OTP or PIN.
past.employee_description:
Completed a Summer Internship at Yes Bank, Noida, India, where I contributed to the Channel Migration project, gaining practical exposure to Retail Branch Banking and Foreign Trade operations. 
Also conducted an in-depth analysis of Dormant, Non-Transacting, and EEFC accounts, helping the bank identify truly inactive accounts, assess potential activation strategies, and focus efforts on re-engaging customers where viable.

past.employer_linkedin_description: RocSearch is an industry leader in customised business intelligence solutions. For over 25 years, we have been creating sustainable advantage for companies using a unique combination of business and financial research with data science.
past.employee_description:
RocSearch is a provider of offshore research and analytics services, offering comprehensive business research solutions, including company research, market assessment, benchmarking, and M&A support.
In my role as a Senior Business Analyst, I was responsible for:

►Managing ad hoc requests for sector intelligence, competitive benchmarking, and industry analysis
►Utilizing qualitative and quantitative frameworks to deliver actionable insights
►Conducting in-depth research using industry-leading databases such as Bloomberg, Avention, Factiva, and Reuters, to ensure accuracy and completeness in analysis
►Developing expertise across various research domains, including business research (both primary and secondary), market entry assessment, competitive intelligence, short-term strategic planning, peer benchmarking, and trend analysis
►Gaining sector-specific experience in telecom, financial services, consulting, consumer goods, oil & gas, and healthcare

past.employer_linkedin_description: A mother's love, a daughter's ambition - a delicious recipe!ChocoWishes specializes in hyper-personalized gifting solutions with an increasing focus towards sustainable and reusable gifts.Our portfolio comprises of giftable desserts that includes a wide portfolio of chocolates, cookies, brownies and other healthy bakes. Custom Printed Chocolates, Whole-wheat Baked Churros and now The Lazy Batter – Cookie Dough are some of our signature products!All our yummy treats are eggless, artisanal and handcrafted fresh in small batches!ChocoWishes is proud to be associated with Boost with Facebook Leaders Network and we’re also an incubatee and grant recipient under the Women Startup Programme 3.0 by NSRCEL, sponsored by Goldman Sachs and IIM B.Our founder Surbhi Singhania has been empaneled with Bizstart to guide aspiring chocolatiers start their own small business anywhere in India.
past.employee_description:
Founded and scaled a bespoke B2B gifting venture, blending chocolate artistry, human insight, and business strategy to create hyper-personalized gifts. My vision was to transform gifting from cookie-cutter ‘Archies cards’ or generic chocolates into hyper-personalized experiences - each box telling a unique story and conveying complex emotions through chocolate art.

Highlights:

►Served 50+ business clients including M&S India, IFF, Accenture UK, and Ibis Hotels; delivered globally
►Translated strategic frameworks (Business Model Canvas, 5Ps) into a high-impact go-to-market strategy
►Secured an investment term sheet from the University of Delhi on product-market fit and business model strength
►Managed high-volume production with ~30% blended net margins
►Achieved 50%+ B2B gifting client retention and positive ratings across platforms such as Amazon, Etsy, WedMeGood & Google
►Featured organically in HerStory, YourStory, IIM Bangalore Newsletters, and other leading platforms
►Built a women-first team, empowering young women to achieve financial independence

Though ChocoWishes eventually closed, it sharpened my ability to navigate ambiguity, lead independent workstreams, and turn strategy into execution.
